visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young girl with long dark hair and bangs sits on a wooden-slatted park bench against a blurry background of green trees and brown soil. She rests her chin on her right hand, looking slightly bored or pensive, while her left leg shakes rapidly. Bright yellow graphic lines radiate from her sneaker to emphasize the motion. (2) Standing in a sunlit park area next to a weathered gray utility pole, the girl drinks from a large clear water bottle. She wears a gray canvas crossbody bag slung over her shoulder. Her right leg is seen vibrating quickly, with a brown leaf lying on the dirt ground nearby. (3) In a vibrant green grassy field, the girl stands wearing a light purple windbreaker jacket. An older female figure in a beige jacket enters the frame from the left, looking toward the girl and gesturing with a slight frown. A red cross-shaped graphic and a variety text box appear to denote a conflict. (4) A series of fast-cut scenes show the girl's lower half in different environments: on a gray tiled sidewalk, sitting at a cafe table with a beverage, and perched on a cream-colored folding suitcase on a city street. In every shot, her leg is in constant, rhythmic motion highlighted by animated graphic effects. (5) The girl is shown in a medium close-up, standing outdoors with lush green and reddish-purple bushes in the background. She talks directly into the camera with an animated expression, using hand gestures to explain her point. Traditional Chinese captions scroll rapidly at the bottom of the screen to match her speech.
